clue.text: Birds to be seen in any wood

definitions.meaning: the knot is a small wading bird of the sandpiper family

definitions.text: to be seen in any wood
definitions.meaning: hard dark rings in timber where a branch once grew are found in almost every plank

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a sandpiper-like shorebird; the other is the whorl in timber left by a branch.

clue.text: Constituents listen without saying a word

indicators.note: the component letters of the next word are taken apart and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: Voters keep quiet and listen rather than speak up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constituents' looks like voters but tells you to rearrange the letters of LISTEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who utters nothing at all is mute, quiet, saying nothing.

clue.text: Returned to carry out the gold by the rear exit

parts.note: someone who has returned is back again
to carry out a task is to do it
OR is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Someone came back to smuggle the gold out the rear way.
explanation.walkthrough: OR for gold comes from heraldry, a frequent crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: A door at the rear of a building is the way out at the back.

clue.text: Seemed alarmed, but made a beginning

definitions.meaning: to jump with sudden fright is to give a start
to commence something is to set it going

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is jumping with fright; the other is commencing something.

clue.text: Heavenly present for use inside and elsewhere

indicators.note: the word for present is placed within the abbreviation for and elsewhere

parts.note: et al. abbreviates the Latin et alibi, and elsewhere
being present means being here

explanation.surface: A divine gift, meant for home use and for use elsewhere too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' looks like a gift but means HERE; 'for use' is a link before the container signal 'inside'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal describes something delicate and otherworldly, of the skies above.

clue.text: An impoverished man-one cannot follow better!

parts.note: to better something is to improve or mend it
the Roman numeral I is one
cannot contracts to can't, written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A poor man laments that no one can do better than him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'follow' joins the pieces: I and CANT come after MEND.
explanation.definitionFit: A mendicant is a beggar, someone poor who lives on alms.

clue.text: An advisory word or two concerning a preliminary course

parts.note: a tip is a piece of advice
as to means concerning or regarding

explanation.surface: A bit of advice about the starter at dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or two' is padding for the surface; the pieces are AN, TIP and AS TO.
explanation.definitionFit: An antipasto is the Italian starter dish served before the main meal.

clue.text: Away always to be in control

parts.note: read as two words, a way, which is a street, abbreviated St
e'er is the poetic contraction of ever, always

explanation.surface: Keep going straight, always holding the wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'Away' into 'a way' for ST (street); E'ER is poetic for ever, the apostrophe dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: To guide a vehicle or a course is to direct and command it.

clue.text: Not all feel a need for a stiff drink

indicators.note: only part of the words a stiff is used, the run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Some people feel they need a stiff drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not all' signals that only part of 'a stiff' is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling Italian wine from Piedmont.

clue.text: The individual running out of personal cover

definitions.text: The individual running out of personal cover

parts.words: The individual running out of personal cover
parts.note: read literally, a person who runs about without any clothes on, as at a sports event

explanation.surface: Someone has dashed out from under a private shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A streaker runs naked through a public place, having shed all clothing.

clue.text: Stayed surprisingly stable

indicators.note: the letters of the first word turn out in an unexpected new order

explanation.surface: Something remained, oddly enough, firmly in place.
explanation.definitionFit: Steady means firm, not wobbling or shifting.

clue.text: A German gets into debt-but not too deeply

indicators.note: the name is found entering inside the words not too, using their middle letters

explanation.surface: A man from Germany runs up debts, but only modestly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deeply' adds to the surface: the name sits just inside 'not too'.
explanation.definitionFit: Otto is a typical German man's first name.

clue.text: Cardinal from the nobility?

parts.note: a cardinal is addressed by a title meaning high rank or distinction, which fits a noble

explanation.surface: Is this churchman of aristocratic birth?
explanation.walkthrough: Cardinals are styled His Eminence; the word also means prominence or high standing.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the formal style for a cardinal and also a word for lofty rank.

clue.text: Sending off even though it's entertaining

definitions.meaning: redirecting traffic or funds sends it off a different way
amusing, as a pleasant pastime is

explanation.definitionFit: It means turning something aside onto another route, and also amusing.

clue.text: Underworld restraint causing some friction

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god and realm of the underworld
a cord is a rope used to tie or restrain

explanation.surface: Being bound in the realm of the dead causes trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: Dis is the classical underworld, a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: Discord is disagreement and strife between people.

clue.text: Sort of director who's not paid

indicators.note: the letters of the next word are sorted out into a different order

explanation.surface: A film boss of a kind who works without a fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A creditor is one owed money, a person still awaiting settlement.

clue.text: Successful speculation the top man holds unfortunate

indicators.note: the word for the top man holds the word for unfortunate inside it

parts.note: a king is the man at the top of a realm
ill means unlucky, as in ill fortune

explanation.surface: A winning gamble, though the boss has bad luck.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a killing is to profit hugely from an investment.

clue.text: Maybe in a list I shall find the letters

indicators.note: the words in a list I could perhaps be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Perhaps there is a list where the correspondence turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: Initials are the first letters of a person's names.

clue.text: Went ahead with internal pain and drained

indicators.note: the pain word goes internal, inside the word for went ahead

parts.note: someone who went ahead led the way
an ache is a dull pain

explanation.surface: Someone pressed on despite a stomach ache and was exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: Leached means drawn out by liquid seeping through, emptied of content.

clue.text: Dispatch in which military people scoffed about support

indicators.note: the two words go about, around the word for support placed between them

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
to scoff food is to eat it greedily
a leg is a support, as on a table

explanation.surface: Soldiers wolf down food around a table leg, so send them away.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is the Royal Engineers, a regiment of the British army.
explanation.definitionFit: To relegate is to consign or demote someone to a lower place.

clue.text: People after a last word

indicators.note: the word for people comes after the letter A

parts.note: men are people

explanation.surface: Folk follow one final remark.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' is used for its letter, while 'after' places MEN behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Amen is said at the close of a prayer, its final word.

clue.text: Fancy tossing a die?

indicators.note: throwing a die scatters it, so its letters land in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Would you like to throw a single dice?
explanation.definitionFit: A fancy is a notion or whim, a thought.

clue.text: A newsman tried desperately, encompassing nothing

indicators.note: the rearranged letters surround the figure for nothing
tried in desperation is jumbled into a new order

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A journalist made frantic attempts and achieved zero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desperately' makes EDITR from TRIED, and 'encompassing' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An editor is a senior journalist in charge of a newspaper.

clue.text: Boast of opposing a relative

parts.note: v is short for versus, against
an aunt is a relative

explanation.surface: Bragging about being against an aunt.
explanation.definitionFit: To vaunt is to brag about something.

clue.text: Hit by industrial action

definitions.meaning: to hit is to ... a blow

explanation.definitionFit: It means a blow and also a walkout by workers.

clue.text: Finding fault is all-important

explanation.definitionFit: It means censorious and also crucial or decisive.

clue.text: Invest when one point down maybe

parts.note: E is east, one point of the compass

indicators.note: the word down could perhaps be rearranged

explanation.surface: Invest money when your score is a point behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges DOWN to NDOW after E.
explanation.definitionFit: To endow is to give money or qualities to, to invest with them.

clue.text: Jet base supplied with everything required

parts.note: to well is to gush or spurt like a jet of water
to found something is to base or establish it

explanation.surface: An airfield for jets has all it needs.
explanation.walkthrough: Both words are verbs here: a jet wells up, and to base is to found.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-found means fully equipped, as a well-found ship.
